method: Same event = multilingual-e5-small embeddings plus a shared-name test. One row per distinct piece of copy, because agency text runs under many mastheads. Constructions from spaCy's parse, kept in five separate classes (active / passive with the actor named / passive with the actor gone / intransitive / nominal) and compared among native-English outlets only. Terms from a fixed lexicon applied identically to everyone. Differences are printed as a complete census of an event covered by 6+ distinct voices - every variant, with who used it, verbatim and linked. No scores, no percentages, no characterisation of any outlet.
